serviceRequests.title: Water leak in basement mechanical room
serviceRequests.description: Water leak detected in basement mechanical room near electrical panel. Water is pooling on the floor and appears to be coming from an overhead pipe joint. Spreading toward the main electrical distribution panel. Immediate attention needed to prevent electrical hazard.

serviceRequests.title: HVAC unit grinding noise
serviceRequests.description: HVAC unit on the roof of Building C is making a grinding noise. The noise is intermittent and only occurs during peak cooling hours (1PM-5PM). Tenants on the 4th floor are complaining about reduced airflow and unusual vibrations. Unit is a Carrier 50XC model, installed 2019.

serviceRequests.title: Emergency exit lights not working - 3rd floor
serviceRequests.description: Multiple emergency exit lights on the 3rd floor of Building B are not illuminating. Both the hallway exit signs near stairwell A and stairwell B are affected. This is a fire code compliance issue that needs prompt resolution.
serviceRequests.notes: Technician has replaced 2 of 4 units, waiting on parts for remaining

serviceRequests.title: Additional power outlets needed in conference room
serviceRequests.description: Conference Room B in Building A needs 4 additional duplex outlets installed along the south wall. The room is being converted to a hybrid meeting space and needs power for monitors, cameras, and laptop docking stations. Low priority — can be scheduled during off-hours.

serviceRequests.title: Elevator stuck between floors
serviceRequests.description: Elevator #2 in Building A is stuck between floors 5 and 6. No passengers are currently inside (confirmed by security cameras). The elevator was last serviced 3 months ago. Display panel shows error code E-47. Building management has cordoned off the area.

serviceRequests.title: Parking lot lights flickering
serviceRequests.description: Multiple light poles in the east parking lot are flickering intermittently. Affects approximately 6 poles in Section D. Employees have reported feeling unsafe walking to their cars after dark. Could be a ballast issue or wiring problem in the underground conduit.

serviceRequests.title: Restroom plumbing backup - 2nd floor
serviceRequests.description: Men's restroom on 2nd floor of Building B has a backed-up toilet and slow-draining sinks. The issue started yesterday afternoon and has gotten progressively worse. Janitorial staff has placed out-of-order signs.

serviceRequests.title: Broken window seal - office 412
serviceRequests.description: Window seal in office 412 has failed. Condensation forming between the double panes. Draft noticeable near the window. Not urgent but affecting employee comfort and energy efficiency.
